approved_clarifications: Quicksand explicitly prevents movement-increasing effects from bypassing its one-Position cap.
Poisonous Gas restricts players to Gambits or Tactics as categories rather than imposing a one-card ceiling, sends Tactics to the Graveyard, and uses a Reserve card for the no-Tactic penalty.
Disrupted Supply Lines restores its original symmetric effect for any player physically here.
Supply Depot keys its bonus to the controller starting their turn here.
Refuge also rewards Withdrawal to the Territory, in addition to Fall Back.
Command Tent clarifies interaction with additional Actions by permitting Actions in both phases and restricting the first Action in each phase.

territories.name: Quicksand
territories.text: A player who begins their Movement here cannot Advance or Fall Back more than one Position or use an effect to increase their movement that turn. Retreat is unaffected.

territories.name: Poisonous Gas

territories.name: Smuggler's Run
territories.text:
During Opening or Denouement, as an Action, this Territory's controller, while here, may stash 1 card from Hand face down beneath it.
While here and controlling this Territory, they may play the stashed card for its Action effect or set it as a Gambit.
At the start of their turn, if they control this Territory, they may return the stashed card to Hand. If they lose control, it is discarded.
